title: Update Scholar Gold logo to match provided gold circular design and replace app icons

requirements.text: Generate a new Scholar Gold logo/app-icon image that visually matches the user-provided reference (uploaded Screenshot_2026_0210_153957.jpg and the provided HTML/CSS design): deep navy radial-gradient background, ornate/gold circular border with gold glow, central book icon, and the text “Scholar Gold” with metallic gold styling plus the subtitle “MADE BY PD”. Export as PNG assets in standard icon sizes.

quotes: Make the logo like this. Use photo or following code
The user has uploaded 1 image(s): Screenshot_2026_0210_153957.jpg.

acceptanceCriteria: New PNG image assets exist under frontend/public/assets/generated with cache-safe filenames and at minimum sizes 32x32, 192x192, and 512x512.
The exported images clearly match the reference look: navy radial background, gold circular motif/border with glow, central book icon, and readable “Scholar Gold” + “MADE BY PD” text.
The 32x32 favicon remains legible and recognizable at small size (no muddy/blurred text artifacts).

requirements.text: Update all frontend references that currently use the v2 Scholar Gold icon filenames to use the newly generated cache-safe filenames, including (1) favicon/app icon links in frontend/index.html and (2) the brand logo image rendered in the authenticated Header and the Login screen Header.

quotes: Make the logo like this. Use photo or following code

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html no longer references scholar-gold-*-v2.* files and instead references the new v3 (or otherwise cache-safe) filenames for 32x32, 192x192, and 512x512 icons.

frontend/src/components/Header.tsx and frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx no longer reference /assets/generated/scholar-gold-app-icon-v2.dim_512x512.png and instead reference the new logo/app-icon filename.
After a normal reload (no manual cache clearing), the browser tab favicon and the in-app brand logo both display the new gold circular design.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or anything in frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Keep all user-facing text in English.
No backend/canister changes are required for this logo update.
nonGoals: Changing the app name (it must remain “Scholar Gold”).
Adding new product features or changing authentication/profile/business logic.
Reworking overall app theming beyond what is necessary to swap the logo/icon assets.

required: Ornate circular gold-and-navy logo with central book icon and gold title/subtitle (scholar-gold-app-icon-v3.dim_512x512.png)
Highly legible small favicon version of the same mark (scholar-gold-favicon-v3.dim_32x32.png)
